name: Sanyo Electric Railway
summary: Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. operates as a diversified Japanese company with core activities in transportation and real estate. Its extensive transportation offerings include railway services, ropeways, and an amusement park, complemented by passenger car transport, travel agencies, taxi services, and automobile management. In the real estate sector, the company manages property rentals and sales, alongside broader land and building development. Beyond these central operations, Sanyo Electric Railway provides a wide range of services such as food service, ticket consignment, futsal court rentals, and the management of department and merchandise stores. It also engages in advertising, insurance agency work, employment placement, security services, and business process contracting. Technical and support functions involve vehicle manufacturing, civil engineering (from surveying to construction), automobile and electrical maintenance, and train cleaning. Additionally, the company develops computer software, offers information processing services, and provides building maintenance, mat/mop rental, and pest control solutions. Founded in 1907, Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. is based in Akashi, Japan.
